title: Average response time
prompt: Return the mean of input, or 0 when empty.

title: Largest sensor reading
prompt: Return the largest number, or null for an empty array.
solution: function solve(input) { return input.length ? Math.max(...input) : null; }
hint: Handle empty input before Math.max.

title: Smallest price
prompt: Return the smallest number, or null when empty.
solution: function solve(input) { return input.length ? Math.min(...input) : null; }
hint: Math.min accepts separate arguments.

title: Clamp the volume
prompt: Input is [value,min,max]. Clamp value to the inclusive bounds.
hint: Combine Math.min and Math.max.

title: Calculate a discount
prompt: Input is [price,percentage]. Return discounted price rounded to two decimals.
hint: Multiply by the remaining percentage.

title: Factorial for combinations
prompt: Return n factorial for nonnegative integer input; 0 factorial is 1.
solution: function solve(input) { let n=1; for(let i=2;i<=input;i++)n*=i; return n;  }
hint: Use a product initialized to 1.

title: Prime checker
prompt: Return whether integer input is prime.
solution: function solve(input) { if(input<2)return false; for(let i=2;i*i<=input;i++)if(input%i===0)return false; return true; }
hint: Check divisors up to the square root.

title: Greatest common divisor
prompt: Input is two nonnegative integers. Return their GCD.
solution: function solve(input) { let [a,b]=input; while(b){[a,b]=[b,a%b]} return a; }
hint: Use the Euclidean algorithm.

title: Fibonacci cache value
prompt: Return Fibonacci(n), starting F(0)=0, F(1)=1.
solution: function solve(input) { let a=0,b=1; for(let i=0;i<input;i++)[a,b]=[b,a+b]; return a; }
hint: Keep the previous two values.

title: Anagram review
prompt: Input two strings. Ignore case and ASCII spaces. Return whether they are anagrams.
solution: function solve(input) { const norm=s=>s.toLowerCase().replace(/ /g,"").split("").sort().join(""); return norm(input[0])===norm(input[1]); }
hint: Sort normalized characters.

title: Remove duplicate tags
prompt: Return unique array values in first-seen order.
hint: Set preserves insertion order.

title: Chunk a batch
prompt: Input [array,size], size is a positive integer. Return chunks.
solution: function solve(input) { const out=[]; for(let i=0;i<input[0].length;i+=input[1])out.push(input[0].slice(i,i+input[1])); return out; }
hint: Advance by chunk size.

title: Flatten one level

title: Rotate a carousel
prompt: Input [array,k], k nonnegative. Rotate right by k.
solution: function solve(input) { const [a,k]=input;if(!a.length)return []; const n=k%a.length;return n?[...a.slice(-n),...a.slice(0,-n)]:a; }
hint: Reduce k modulo length.

title: Compact optional values
prompt: Remove falsy values using JavaScript truthiness.
hint: Boolean is usable as a predicate.

title: Median salary
prompt: Return numeric median; null if empty. Do not rely on lexicographic sort.
solution: function solve(input) { if(!input.length)return null; const a=[...input].sort((a,b)=>a-b),m=Math.floor(a.length/2);return a.length%2?a[m]:(a[m-1]+a[m])/2; }
hint: Sort numerically before selecting the middle.

title: Running total
prompt: Return cumulative sums.
hint: Keep an accumulator.

title: Second distinct score
prompt: Return the second largest distinct number, or null.
solution: function solve(input) { const a=[...new Set(input)].sort((a,b)=>b-a);return a.length>1?a[1]:null; }
hint: Deduplicate before sorting.

title: Group tickets by status
prompt: Input array of {status,id}. Return object status -> array of IDs, preserving order.
solution: function solve(input) { const o=Object.create(null);for(const x of input){(o[x.status]??=[]).push(x.id)}return o; }
hint: Initialize each group once.

title: Count labels
prompt: Return an object mapping each string to its frequency. Labels contain letters only.
solution: function solve(input) { const o=Object.create(null); for(const x of input)o[x]=(o[x]||0)+1;return o; }
hint: Increment the count for each label.

title: Read nested setting
prompt: Input [object,path] with dot-separated keys. Return null when missing.
solution: function solve(input) { let v=input[0];for(const k of input[1].split(".")){if(v==null||!Object.hasOwn(v,k))return null;v=v[k]}return v; }
hint: Missing differs from falsy.

title: Two sum indices
prompt: Input [numbers,target]. Return first pair found scanning rightward, or null.
solution: function solve(input) { const seen=new Map();for(let i=0;i<input[0].length;i++){const n=input[0][i],j=seen.get(input[1]-n);if(j!==undefined)return [j,i];if(!seen.has(n))seen.set(n,i)}return null; }
hint: Remember earlier numbers in a Map.

title: Binary search
prompt: Input [sortedUniqueNumbers,target]. Return index, or -1.
solution: function solve(input) { let l=0,r=input[0].length-1;while(l<=r){const m=(l+r)>>1,v=input[0][m];if(v===input[1])return m;if(v<input[1])l=m+1;else r=m-1}return -1; }
hint: Halve the search range.

title: Balanced brackets
prompt: Input contains only ()[]{}. Return whether properly balanced.
solution: function solve(input) { const s=[],pairs={")":"(","]":"[","}":"{"};for(const c of input){if("([{ ".trim().includes(c))s.push(c);else if(s.pop()!==pairs[c])return false}return s.length===0; }
hint: Use a stack for opening brackets.

title: Maximum streak sum
prompt: Return maximum contiguous subarray sum; 0 for empty.
solution: function solve(input) { if(!input.length)return 0;let cur=input[0],best=cur;for(const x of input.slice(1)){cur=Math.max(x,cur+x);best=Math.max(best,cur)}return best; }
hint: Kadane’s algorithm tracks best ending here.
